history: always-repro'd across v1.6.2112 (2021-12-08, the release that added -HV 2021 support) .. v1.9.2607 and main-debug; not a regression -- -HV2021 gives the for-loop induction variable a real nested scope, so the legacy same-scope redefinition-merge path that emits -Wfor-redefinition is never entered, and DXC has no general shadow warning in any HV mode
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: HV2021 for-loops give the induction variable real block scope, so the legacy -Wfor-redefinition merge path (gated on Scope::ForDeclScope, HV<2021 only) never fires; DXC has no general shadow warning in any mode (confirmed with a non-loop block-shadow control), so this is a request for new diagnostic coverage rather than a broken existing check. Reproduces on every release that has ever shipped -HV 2021 (v1.6.2112..v1.9.2607) and on main-debug.
title: Report warning when loop variable shadows one from outer scope in HLSL 2021
